equations.affine: y=tanh(W*x+b); every Dense and every MLP layer, including output; W row-major with row-interleaved bias
equations.lstm: i=sigmoid((Wi*x+Ui*h)+bi); f=sigmoid((Wf*x+Uf*h)+bf); o=sigmoid((Wo*x+Uo*h)+bo); g=tanh((Wg*x+Ug*h)+bg); c'=f*c+i*g; h'=o*tanh(c'); state=[h,c]
equations.concat: concatenate source ports in increasing resolved inputOrdinal; fan-out reads the same source values
equations.split: contiguous source slices in outputSizes order; zero-based ports
equations.arithmetic: sigmoid(x)=1/(1+exp(-x)); Float32 intermediates; scalar/SSE2 dot accumulation may differ within parity tolerances
